detail.not-found: The requested equipment could not be found.
detail.period-description: Select the dates when you need the equipment to check its availability.
detail.available-for-period: The availability check shows this equipment is operationally available for the selected dates. Your request will be validated again when submitted and may be rejected if another restriction applies.

request-errors.status-changed: The rental request could not be submitted because the equipment is no longer available. Check its availability again.
request-errors.blocking-incident: You cannot request this equipment because it has an unresolved blocking maintenance incident.
request-errors.reserved: This equipment has a reservation overlapping your selected dates. Choose another period.
request-errors.rental-overlap: This equipment already has a recorded rental that overlaps your selected dates. Even if the earlier check showed availability, this period cannot be requested. Choose different dates.
request-errors.company-mismatch: The equipment does not belong to the selected rental company.
request-errors.not-found: The equipment or requested resource was not found. Refresh the page and try again.
request-errors.reservations-check-failed: The equipment reservations could not be verified. Please try again.
request-errors.incidents-check-failed: The maintenance restrictions could not be verified. Please try again.
request-errors.invalid-request: The request details are invalid. Check the dates, equipment, and rental information.
request-errors.availability-check-failed: The current availability could not be checked. Please try again.
request-errors.generic: The rental request could not be submitted. Please try again.
request-errors.requester-role: Your account does not have permission to request this rental.
request-errors.not-available: This equipment is unavailable for the requested period. There may be a reservation or operational restriction. Choose different dates.
request-errors.duplicate-request: You already have a pending or approved request for this equipment with overlapping dates. Check My Requests before trying again.
request-errors.past-date: You cannot submit a rental request with a start date in the past. Select a valid period beginning today or later.
request-errors.same-company: A construction company cannot rent equipment from itself.
request-errors.subscription-inactive: The rental company needs an active subscription to accept new requests.
request-errors.conflict: The request could not be created because it conflicts with the current rental conditions. Review the dates and your existing requests. Contact the rental company if the issue persists.
request-errors.unauthorized: Your session has expired or could not be verified. Please sign in again.
request-errors.network: We could not connect to the server. Check your connection and try again.
request-errors.server-error: Something went wrong while processing your request. Please try again later.

list.title: Equipment incidents
list.subtitle: Register and review problems reported with your company equipment.
list.shortcut-description: Review issues that need attention and manage equipment restrictions.
list.shortcut-open-description: Identify reports that still require attention.
list.shortcut-restriction-description: Check which equipment has been temporarily withdrawn.
list.shortcut-return-description: Confirm inspection after resolving blocking incidents.
list.load-error: Incident records could not be loaded.
list.empty-description: Report an incident when equipment experiences a problem.
list.resolve-warning: Confirm the issue has been addressed. Resolving does not make the equipment available.
list.resolve-success: Incident resolved. Equipment under maintenance remains unavailable until manually reactivated.
list.restriction-warning: Confirm to mark this incident as blocking and temporarily withdraw the equipment from new rentals. This does not cancel existing rentals or make the equipment available again.
list.restriction-success: The incident is now blocking. The equipment remains under maintenance and cannot receive new rentals.
list.reactivation-description: Request reactivation of equipment under maintenance. The server checks inspection, blocking incidents, active rentals and maintenance after return.
list.reactivate-warning: Confirm the technical inspection. The operation proceeds only if safety and availability requirements are met.
list.inspection-confirmed: I confirm the equipment was inspected, is fit to operate, and has no active rentals.
list.reactivation-success: Equipment reactivated and available again. Incident history was preserved.
